dct_description_sm: In the past 20 years, dendrochronological sampling in Labrador has been spotty and consists of mainly white spruce, with Eastern Labrador being relatively unexplored both ecologically and climatologically. In the light of recent extensive dendroclimatic and dendroecological studies conducted in the northern and western regions of Labrador, eastern Labrador represents the last area in a contiguous sampling grid across the forested regions of Labrador. This thesis fills this gap by employing similar sampling and analytical methods to other studies in adjacent regions in order to form strong analytical tools that are applicable both on a local and a regional scale. With spatially systematic sampling and a strong representation of black spruce and balsam fir, this data set will provide a much stronger basis for analysis and will be a big step toward understanding the growth sensitivity regime of conifers in Labrador.
dct_title_s: Dendroclimatic records of 3 conifer species: Picea mariana, Abies balsamea and Larix laricina in South Eastern Labrador, Canada
